title: How to Create a Website With AI: Tools and Steps for Beginners in India
seoTitle: How to Create Website With AI: Tools and Steps (India)
seoDescription: Create a website with AI: pick a builder like Wix or Hostinger or a coding assistant like Claude, add a .in domain, then check facts, SEO and privacy.
excerpt: A side-by-side table of nine AI website tools with official prices, how .in domains work through NIXI, and a launch checklist covering accuracy, accessibility and DPDP privacy notices.
